title: My weekend in Paris
instructions: Elena Paris'teki hafta sonunu anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; günleri, yerleri ve sevmediği şeyi karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: Last month, I went to Paris with my sister for the weekend.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: We went by train on Friday evening. It took two and a half hours.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: On Saturday morning, we visited the Eiffel Tower. There were a lot of people, so we waited for an hour.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: In the afternoon, we went to a big museum. My sister loved it, but I was very tired.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: On Saturday evening, we had dinner in a small French restaurant. The food was wonderful, but very expensive.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: On Sunday, it rained, so we went shopping. I bought a red bag and some chocolate.

script.speaker: elena
script.text: We came home on Sunday night. It was a great weekend!
